experiments.scope: The 39-step compression and advice construction of sha256-r39-prefix-v1 as used by the construction (proof.md Sections 2, 10 and 11). Trial 0 runs the shipped program's Attack.claw on the advice pair (our re-signed 39-step pair) (chaining value CV_PUB, a0 = A[4], u = W1) with the folded kernel built for CV_PUB, and runs verify_advice_construction(): the exact 32-bit bit-by-bit DFS fibre solver solve_row_exact on row 16 (G16) and row 17 (G17(g)), exact downward step inversion from steps 10..15 to CV_PUB (invert_downward), and enumeration of a 256-candidate local slice of the step-15 free bits. Trials 1 to 255 draw a chaining value, an even a0 and an odd u from the trial seed, recover a1, build the first message and its partner from the construction, and compare the 39-step trajectories of both with the advice pair. Every trial output is verified by hard assert statements in r39joint.py.
experiments.hypothesis: Hard-asserted in r39joint.py._e1 (capped at <= 16 keys per trial). Trial 0 (16 keys): claw_returned_pair 1, passed_f9 1, passed_f8 1, passed_w17 1, pair_is_published 1, sfs_collision 1, published_w16_is_g 1, published_w17 1, kernel_records 734, claw_ops 6173, blk_census 150, g16_fibre_size 2, g17_fibre_size 1, fibre_dfs_ops 1944 (< 2812 = 1 compression), advice_slice_hits 1, ops_per_cand 408 (< 4 * 2812 = 4 compressions). Trial 1 (10 keys) additionally reports all 7 verify_advice_construction() keys including downward_inv_ok 1 and advice_slice_cands 256 alongside transplant_ok 1, w1_is_u 1, w16_identity 1. Trials 1 to 255: transplant_ok 1 (the states A[6..19] and E[10..19] of both messages equal the advice pair's), w1_is_u 1, w16_identity 1 (W16 - g = F(u) - F(a0) mod 2^32) on all 255.

experiments.scope: Trials 0 to 3 run 4 independent windows of the shipped program (folded 256-lane kernel, every parameter of class P unchanged: DP = low 7 bits zero, table 26,052 words, queue 3,584 (QFULL 3,328), timing wheel 2,048, keep-longer, packed 39-bit records, short-trail skip, MAXS 1536 / CUTP 512, parking stage 2 and the decoupled catch-up D0 82 / KRES 6 as in proof.md Section 3) on 4 first blocks drawn from the organizer trial seeds, cut to 2^22 walk evaluations (16,384 iterations of 256 lanes) each = 2^24 walk evaluations total (3,318 distinct claws and 3,318 distinct claw groups), in check mode: every raw claw is asserted to satisfy F(a0) = F(u), a0 even, u odd and W16 = g by build and expand, and every distinct claw and group is checked for F8, F9, W17 low-8/12-bit matches, 100% distinct (W8, W9, W17, W18) tuples, 256-bin chi-square uniformity of W17 mod 2^8 and W18 mod 2^8, and lag-1 group autocorrelation of (W9 in F9, W17[0], W18[0]). Trial 4 runs one 2^22 window twice in check mode, first with QFULL 64, MAXS 192 and CUTP 64 (forcing stage-2 park/resume and trail cuts) and then with the shipped QFULL 3328, and checks that both find the same claws when neither run drops a pair (the equality relies on zero drops; this seed has none in either run); it then runs the cut scan with the shipped MAXS 1536 on all 256 lanes, and runs the window a third time with the trail-id counter started at 2^20 - 1998 to check that stage 1 ends when the ids run out and stage 2 drains. Trials 0 to 3 also hard-assert that every block of the batched DP-hit groups and batched stage-2 inserts executed (hb_init, hb_sel, hb_close, hb_add, hb_last, hb_ext, hb_v, hb_lp, hb_ins, delta_lanes, qins, qflush, s2_fl), fewer hit groups than DP lanes, at least one stage-2 window conflict, fewer flushes than queued inserts and at least one lane move (every lane move is preceded by a flush call); trial 4's id-exhaustion run asserts that the stop falls inside a partly restarted hit group (stop_grp 1).
experiments.hypothesis: Hard-asserted in r39joint.py (WIN_EXP and serve()): across trials 0..3 (2^24 walk evaluations), distinct_claws = [817, 795, 909, 797] (3,318 total), distinct_groups = [817, 795, 909, 797] (3,318 total, ratio 1.0000), dp_hits = [33229, 32736, 32545, 32820], matches = [1744, 1660, 1771, 1653], stage2_iterations = [2874, 2355, 2659, 2529], raw_claws = [840, 809, 926, 804], passed_f9 = [17, 11, 12, 11] (51 total vs 52.65 expected), passed_f8 = [3, 1, 3, 0] (7 joint F9 & F8 passes vs 3.70 expected), f8_all = [60, 54, 73, 53] (240 total vs 233.30 expected), w17_low8 = [1, 0, 4, 2] (7 total vs 12.96 expected), w17_low12 = [0, 0, 0, 0] (0 total vs 0.81 expected), kernel_records = [730, 714, 710, 699], ops = [22914523, 22090605, 22284239, 21944236], blk_census = [1238, 1238, 1236, 1168]. Over all 3,318 groups serve() asserts 256-bin chi-square of W17 mod 256 is 268.01 (255 df) and W18 mod 256 is 280.20 (255 df), and lag-1 autocorrelation of (W9 in F9, W17[0], W18[0]) passes |r| sqrt(n) < 3 (0.0050, 0.0459, 0.0144; 0.0459 is 2.6 SE, disclosed). Trial 4 (T4_EXP, hard-asserted): the forced run (QFULL 64, MAXS 192, CUTP 64) and the shipped-QFULL run of the same window find identical distinct-claw sets and raw claw counts whenever neither run drops a pair (the equality relies on zero drops; on this seed both runs have drops 0, which is asserted through T4_EXP); the forced run has parks >= 1, resumes >= 1, cuts >= 1 and ends with nothing parked and an empty queue; a cut scan at MAXS 1536 cuts all 256 lanes; a third run of the same window with the trail-id counter started at 2^20 - 1998 ends stage 1 when the ids run out (idc = 2^20, before 16,384 iterations), drains stage 2 to an empty queue with nothing parked and keeps every trail length below 2,048 (check mode); and distinct_claws 473, raw_claws 477, dp_hits 32719, matches 978, stage2_iterations 748, parks 15, resumes 15, cuts 7317, ops 21892301, blk_census 1234, drops 0, idc_stop_iteration 996, idc_stop_stage2_iterations 493.

experiments.scope: Tail replica of proof Section 8 (run 01 of 14): trial 0 runs verify_smc_stats() (hard-asserting stage-18 direct Monte Carlo calibration c18 = 206/65536 and the packed 14-run table EXP with the one-sided 99% and 99.9% Student-t lower bounds above QDECL = -74.52) and the SMC over E18..E23 of the carrier K_P (800 particles; variance-balanced stage lanes 8x512, 8x2048, 8x2048, 4x128, 6x256, 1x4; lazy pool entries) with a known-answer check on the advice pair; trials 1 to 20 draw W8 in F8 and W9 in F9 for every proposal (80 x 2048 each; every particle drives exactly two batches), rebuild rows 24 to 38 and verify every hit by the two 39-step compressions, asserting exact match with EXP['r39-tail-01'].

Across all 14 runs in EXP: 6,326 verified collisions in 45,875,200 proposals, parity classes [1628, 1526, 1556, 1616] (chi-square 4.48 < 7.81), linear-scale unbiased mean log2(mean(Q')) = -74.3399, one-sided 99% Student-t lower bound log2(lcb_lin) = -74.4140 > QDECL = -74.52 (and log-scale 99% bound -74.4156 > -74.52); the one-sided 99.9% Student-t bound (t = 3.852, 13 df) is -74.4489 > -74.52, and QDECL = -74.52 was fixed before the organizer runs by the pre-registered rule: at least 0.01 below the 99.9% bound of the design frozen on private seeds, rounded down to two decimals (one-sided t of the declared value: 6.2110, 13 df, p < 1e-4).
